text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's the matter
with that person...?

Turning my gaze where K.S.Miracle pointed,
I saw a young man
searching for something—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go help look for it!
The ground over there is all muddy, though,
so please wait here, Trainer—"
choice_data_list: It'll be faster if both of us help out.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, understood.
Well then, let's go together!
Please watch your step carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Can I start with a lecture?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry!!
B-But, you see, this time... it's not that I dropped it,
so much as it was taken... by, b-by a puppy.

A rustling in the grass came from a short distance away.
In the shadows there, a puppy was wagging its tail.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Young Man
text_block_list.text:
He loves playing tag—
he keeps coming close and running away over and over.
I just can't keep up on my own feet...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so cute...
It's so fluffy...
Whoa, its whole rear end is wagging with the tail...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, Trainer-san!
This is my cue to step in... right?
I'm sure I can catch up to them."

"KS Miracle is fidgeting restlessly, which is unusual for her.
Running on muddy dirt is a concern... but stopping her here doesn't feel right either."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Whoops. Ahaha, you're nimble!
If you keep looking back at me like that,
you're gonna get caught right away, you know?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There you go.
...Ah, hey! Not over there—
Haha. Ah, geez, you're covered in mud!

...If I said it looked like they were frolicking,
would K.S. Miracle get mad?
Or would she just smile shyly?

Though slipping on her footing again and again,
K.S.Miracle never fell.
In fact, almost as if using those slips to her advantage—

He managed to catch the puppy brilliantly.
KS Miracle smiled radiantly as he hugged
the puppy, who was innocently fawning over him.
